cases.name: resolved bindings, references, capabilities, and exact impacts
cases.manifest:
version: 1
context:
  /moldea/project.md:
    bindings:
      - path: /src/shared.ts
        symbol: projectBinding
    affectedBy:
      - /src/**
      - /src/exact.ts
unresolved:
  architecture:
    category: design
    effect: informational
    description: Architecture remains open.
    resolution: Record the decision.
    related:
      - path: /src/shared.ts
agents:
  reviewer:
    runtime:
      id: custom
    variables:
      REGION:
        description: Deployment region.
    bindings:
      runtimeAgent:
        path: /src/shared.ts
      variableProviders:
        REGION:
          path: /src/shared.ts
    tools:
      deploy:
        name: deploy
        description: Deploys changes when release approval is granted.
        implementation:
          path: /src/shared.ts
          symbol: deploy
        registration:
          path: /src/shared.ts
          symbol: deployTool
        affectedBy:
          - /tools/**
          - /src/exact.ts
    skills:
      audit:
        name: audit
        description: Audits changes when repository verification is required.
        implementation:
          path: /src/shared.ts
        affectedBy:
          - /skills/**
          - /src/exact.ts
    affectedBy:
      - /agents/**
      - /src/exact.ts
    unresolved:
      verification:
        category: testing
        effect: warning
        description: Verification remains incomplete.
        resolution: Complete verification.
        related:
          - path: /src/shared.ts

cases.name: missing, directory, and symlink targets
cases.manifest:
version: 1
context:
  /moldea/project.md:
    bindings:
      - path: /src/c-link.ts
      - path: /src/b-missing.ts
      - path: /src/a-directory
    affectedBy:
      - /impact/c-link.ts
      - /impact/b-directory
      - /impact/a-missing.ts
      - /impact/**
agents:
  reviewer:
    runtime:
      id: custom
    tools:
      deploy:
        name: deploy
        description: Deploys changes when release approval is granted.
        implementation:
          path: /tools/missing.ts
    skills:
      audit:
        name: audit
        description: Audits changes when repository verification is required.
        implementation:
          path: /skills/link.ts
